name: Stephen Hawking
bio: Born in 1942, on the three-hundredth anniversary of Galileo's death. He showed in 1974 that black holes radiate, and argued in 1976 that they destroy information — an argument he publicly abandoned in 2004. He described himself as a positivist.

contributions.title: Hawking radiation
contributions.note: Quantum effects make black holes emit thermal radiation.

contributions.title: Information loss
contributions.note: Argued evaporation destroys information; reversed in 2004.

beliefs: Positivist about theories; for three decades held that gravity introduces a new level of unpredictability.
philosophy: Positivism: a theory is a model that predicts observations.

guest.whyInvited: He took Einstein's dice and threw them into a black hole.
